question: In October 2020, India’s first fully virtual home school was inaugurated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

__
 
• In October 2020,** India’s** **first fully virtual home school** was inaugurated in **Uttarakhand**.
 
• Through the first full virtual home school to be operated from Uttarakhand, Indian knowledge tradition, Vedic mathematics, science and Indian classical music, culture, arts and traditions will be recognized globally and Sanskrit will also be affiliated through Cambridge board to schools all over the world Will be able to read.
